redfin.remarks: Spacious 5-Bedroom Home with a Huge Loft & RV Parking ! Welcome to 3317 Vahn Ln, a spacious 3,847 sq. ft. two-story home built in 2006, offering an abundance of living space and flexibility for today's lifestyle. This home features 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms with 3,847 sq. ft. of living space, built in 2006. The kitchen offers granite countertops . Upstairs, a huge loft is spacious enough for a pool table, and there is additional craft room or office space . There is also room for RV parking, and the two-story floor plan provides plenty of room to spread out. One of the standout features is the oversized upstairs loft, creating a fantastic bonus space for a game room, entertainment area, or gathering space. There's also an additional area that can easily be transformed into a home office, craft room, or creative space. With five bedrooms, four bathrooms, generous living space, and room for an RV, this home offers the flexibility and space to accommodate a variety of needs.
